qualification: Transcribed from the supplied workbook; manufacturer claims have not been independently verified. Network and storage entries are recommendations requiring OEM/workload validation.

assumptions.note: App planning assumptions, not workbook specifications: 40U usable space, 15% ancillary IT allowance and PUE 1.20. Dedicated network/storage racks are excluded.

platforms.name: HGX B200
platforms.configuration: 8 GPUs per server; host CPUs depend on OEM
platforms.scalableUnit: 8-GPU NVLink domain; scale-out cluster sized by fabric
platforms.storage: WEKA or VAST; DDN EXAScaler for parallel I/O
platforms.network: 400 Gb/s InfiniBand or RoCE Ethernet; validate OEM NIC topology
platforms.considerations: 256 servers is a design choice, not a fixed product unit. Validate rack power, CUDA stack and workload throughput.

platforms.name: HGX B300
platforms.configuration: 8 GPUs per server; host CPUs depend on OEM
platforms.scalableUnit: 8-GPU NVLink domain; scale-out cluster sized by fabric
platforms.storage: WEKA or VAST; DDN EXAScaler for parallel I/O
platforms.network: Up to 800 Gb/s ConnectX-8; Quantum-X800 InfiniBand or Spectrum-X Ethernet
platforms.considerations: 256 servers requires a validated network design. Size for model memory and concurrency; benchmark FP64-heavy HPC separately.

platforms.name: GB200 NVL72
platforms.memory: 186 GB HBM3e per GPU; 13.4 TB per rack
platforms.configuration: 2 Grace CPUs + 4 GPUs per compute tray

platforms.name: GB300 NVL72

platforms.configuration: 2 Grace CPUs + 4 GPUs per compute tray

training.reason: WEKA: parallel file access. VAST: shared file/object data. DDN: Lustre parallel I/O. Shortlist for dataset reads and checkpoint writes.
training.considerations: Size sustained reads, checkpoint bursts and metadata IOPS at full concurrency. Test restart time, usable capacity, RDMA/GPU-direct support and failure recovery.

inference.reason: Shared model and retrieval data with fast loading. Local NVMe caches hot models; shared storage supports replicas and updates.
inference.considerations: Measure cold-start time and retrieval latency. Storage is less critical once a model resides in HBM, unless retrieval or KV-cache offload adds I/O. Validate engine integration.

tuning.vendors: WEKA; VAST; DDN EXAScaler for larger parallel jobs
tuning.reason: Fast reuse of datasets and base models, plus checkpoints across repeated experiments. Choice depends on dataset size and concurrency.
tuning.considerations: Size for simultaneous jobs, full versus adapter-only checkpoints and retention. Check snapshots, dataset versioning, access isolation and restore time.

hpc.vendors: DDN EXAScaler; WEKA; VAST where application-qualified
hpc.reason: DDN: Lustre parallel filesystem. WEKA: parallel file access. VAST: shared multiprotocol data. Select using application I/O benchmarks.
hpc.considerations: Validate POSIX/MPI-IO behavior, small-file metadata, large-file bandwidth and client support. Separate scratch retention from durable backup.

digitalTwin.vendors: VAST; WEKA; DDN EXAScaler for simulation-heavy workloads
digitalTwin.reason: Shared assets, sensor datasets and simulation outputs. VAST supports file/object access; WEKA and DDN address parallel simulation I/O.
digitalTwin.considerations: Validate NFS/SMB/S3 needs, ingest latency, asset versioning and metadata scale. Size simulation and visualization separately; confirm RTX needs for rendering.

mixed.vendors: VAST; WEKA; DDN EXAScaler if parallel AI/HPC dominates
mixed.reason: VAST for shared multiprotocol datasets; WEKA for concurrent AI/file workloads; DDN when parallel simulation and training dominate.
mixed.considerations: Benchmark workloads together. Validate tenant isolation, QoS, protocol support, snapshots, backup and lifecycle tiers; compare usable capacity and total cost.
